assertion_refresh_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T_WC_T2S_SERIE.ID_SERIE FROM T_WC_T2S_SERIE JOIN T_WC_WIKIDATA_ITEM_PROPERTY ON T_WC_T2S_SERIE.ID_WIKIDATA = T_WC_WIKIDATA_ITEM_PROPERTY.ID_WIKIDATA JOIN T_WC_T2S_ITEM ON T_WC_WIKIDATA_ITEM_PROPERTY.ID_ITEM = T_WC_T2S_ITEM.ID_WIKIDATA WHERE T_WC_WIKIDATA_ITEM_PROPERTY.ID_PROPERTY = 'P840' AND T_WC_T2S_ITEM.ITEM_LABEL = 'London' ORDER BY T_WC_T2S_SERIE.IMDB_RATING_WEIGHTED DESC LIMIT 8
